comparison: engine mesh roughing round 6 (ours, Task F: Fusion-matched adaptive settings + flat-area levels + hard allowance check) vs Fusion OVERALL ROUGHING

common.zmap: verify/zmap.py two-pass prefix-stock chunking (--jobs 8), --flute 25.4 (over-flute moves: tip > flute below the material surface at that XY before the move)

ours.op: engine.cli rough (ocl AdaptiveWaterline islands per Z level + area.Adaptive2d clearing, levels parallel in fork pool, hard radial-allowance post-check)

params.final_floor_choice: matched Fusion ZMIN 24.95 (0.185 mm above the 24.765 floor) instead of floor + 0.381 axial leave (25.146): ZMIN 24.95 is closer to what Fusion actually cuts

fusion.op: OVERALL ROUGHING, T3 D=0.5in CR=0.005in bullnose, S7500 (lines 1-40321 of reference/1001.nc, G20)

top3_reasons_from_data.reason: intermediate levels re-machine the whole open box: 4 extra full-area levels between stock top and the floor
top3_reasons_from_data.data: ours cuts 135909 mm vs Fusion 48543 mm (2.8x). The floor band tells the story: 20-25 mm ours 19133 vs Fusion 15876 mm (comparable - one full-area drop to the floor does the job), but bands 35-40 + 40-45: ours 114395 mm vs Fusion 28140 mm - our levels 41.91/40.291/39.601/35.301 each re-traverse the whole stock rectangle (~42481 mm^2/level) that is already open; with MAX stepdown 19.05 the floor could be dropped in one step from ~44. zmap stock-sim air cutting 18.4% vs Fusion 9.9%. (Cutting outside the final-part footprint is NOT the issue: ours 13.6% vs Fusion 14.1%.)

top3_reasons_from_data.reason: retract/link moves between regions and levels
top3_reasons_from_data.data: ours: 19 retracts to clearance (Z62.96) + 3365 lift-links (z+1.9 with re-plunge at ramp feed) + 3 notclear links; rapid path 86221 mm vs Fusion 20416 mm (345 s at 15000 mm/min vs 82 s).

top3_reasons_from_data.reason: region order: every region entered via full retract + XY traverse + helix/plunge at ramp feed
top3_reasons_from_data.data: ours 16 regions across 6 levels ([42.841, 41.91, 40.291, 39.601, 35.301, 24.95]); every region entry = retract to Z62.96, XY rapid, then helix/plunge at ramp feed (8266 mm plunge length = 391 s at 1270 mm/min, 244 s more). Fusion's measured program (8 major levels, [47.62, 45.72, 43.81, 41.91, 40.0, 38.1, 36.2, 24.95]) keeps far more passes tool-down between levels.

allowance_check_note.round5_failure: 0.3 mm radial allowance lost near (26.2, 6.65) at Z 41.96 (centre 6.277 mm vs intended 6.65)
allowance_check_note.fix: waterline sampling 0.5->0.1 mm (min 0.02), loop decimate 0.1->0.05, Adaptive2d tolerance 0.1->0.05, plus HARD post-check in engine/rough.py: every CL point at a level's Z must stay >= tool_r + radial_leave - 0.02 from that level's island loops (run aborted with location otherwise; also covered by engine/test_engine.py)
allowance_check_note.result: this run passed the hard check at all 6 levels

notes: Ours leaves ~0.381 mm on walls by design (radial leave) plus a 0.05 mm waterline cutter-radius margin; floor left = 0.185 mm (final level matched to Fusion ZMIN 24.95).

Fusion's op settings say MAX stepdown 19.05 mm, but its posted program machines a ~1.905 mm level grid from 47.62 down to ~32.4 plus flat-area drops and one big step to ZMIN 24.95 - see fusion.levels_measured_from_gcode.
Cycle times: feed moves at their F words, rapids assumed 15000 mm/min.
Fusion roughing section carries no G41/G42; wear-model sim is exact for this split.
